Get told about new messages
PingMe shows a notification when a message comes in, and one quiet notification while it stays connected. Android asks you to allow this.
Stay connected
Android stops apps in the background to save battery. If it stops PingMe, your messages arrive late. Allowing this lets PingMe keep its connections open. It sleeps them when your phone is idle.
PingMe can already stay connected.
Use your contacts
PingMe uses your contacts for names and photos, matching people by phone number. Your contacts never leave your phone.
Connect your first network
You can add more networks later in Settings > Accounts.
